title: lintrix configuration
description: lintrix.config.json: the rules to run, the files they apply to, and the settings both the native binary and the npm CLI read (docs/rules.md "Config").

$schema.description: This schema, for editor validation. Neither the native binary nor the npm CLI reads it.

extends.description: Presets filling the base layer before "rules".

plugins.description: A prefix to the JavaScript module that defines its rules. A rule from one is named "prefix/rule". The npm CLI imports these; the native binary reads the keys, so it can tell a plugin rule from a misspelled name.

additionalProperties.description: A module specifier: a package name, or a path relative to this file.

rules.description: Rule severities and options, by rule name.

overrides.description: Rule settings applied, in order, to the files each entry's globs match.

ignores.description: Globs whose files are not linted at all.

project.description: The tsconfig the type-aware rules use for files no "projects" glob claims, relative to this file or absolute.

projects.description: Per-glob tsconfigs for the type-aware rules; the first entry a file matches wins.

reportUnusedDisableDirectives.description: How a disable directive that suppressed nothing is reported. `true` means "warn", `false` means "off".

eslintDirectives.description: Honor `eslint-disable` comments as well as `lintrix-disable` ones.

binary.description: The native lintrix executable the npm CLI drives: a path relative to this file, or a name to find on PATH. The bundled WASM build runs when it is absent or cannot be resolved.

ruleSetting.description: A severity, or an array of the severity followed by the rule's options.
